One day, she is followed back by the famous “K-cup-chan,” inspiring her to take even bolder photos, until she accidentally sends one to her friends Karen and Sota. Mortified, she is comforted when Karen reveals one of her own sexy videos, only for Tsumugi to realize Karen is actually the girl she admired online. From there, their excitement builds, and things quickly take a steamy turn involving all three of them...
